violations.why: Compute ISR (prio 6) can preempt the RR ISR between its write and read-back of the variable, so the RR ISR reads the compute ISR's value.
Compute ISR can preempt between the two reads in the RR ISR and change the value, so the two reads can differ.
Compute ISR can preempt after the RR ISR's write and overwrite the value before the RR ISR reads it at line 461.
Compute ISR (prio 6) can preempt the FL ISR between its two writes, so it can read the intermediate value.
Compute ISR can preempt the RR ISR after it stores RT4 and overwrite it before RR uses it.
Compute ISR can preempt the FL ISR after it stores RT4 and overwrite it before FL uses it.
Compute ISR can preempt the RR ISR after it stores RT_h and overwrite it before RR reads it.
Compute ISR can preempt the FL ISR after it stores RT3 and overwrite it before FL reads it.
